title: Four-qubit VQC
description: Four-qubit VQC: angle encoding, two variational layers with entangling gates, and measurement.

title: Experimental pipeline
description: Preprocessing fitted on the training split only, the VQC and the classical comparators on the same four inputs, and the metrics computed on both splits.

title: Test AUC and gap versus training data used
description: Test AUC (top) and gap (bottom) as a function of the percentage of the training split used (means over 30 seeds).

title: Shared-embedding comparison
description: The shared-embedding comparison fits logistic regression after freezing a representation learned with the VQC. Equal input coordinates do not imply equal model capacity or fitting. PCA4 also feeds separate VQC and classical baselines.

title: Learned representations and generalization
description: Training and validation ROC-AUC for the PCA4 quantum and logistic baselines, the jointly learned encoder–VQC, and logistic regression on the frozen quantum-trained embedding. AUC means are aggregated fold-first. Different encoder inputs and fits prevent an attribution of the improvement to the quantum circuit alone.

title: Geometric objective and training schedule
description: Development AUC with two geometry objectives and two fitting schedules. The lower panel shows paired fidelity-minus-Gaussian validation differences within each fold, averaged across seeds. Positive values favor fidelity; the schedule comparison is confounded by training budget and optimization.

title: Same-embedding readout comparison
description: The top panel contrasts mean training and validation AUC. The bottom panel gives fold-level validation differences, LR on frozen z minus VQC, averaged over three seeds. The reversed fifth fold and the small mean difference temper any claim of readout superiority.
